mapper.sql: id, trade_id, uid, symbol, is_buyer, trade_time, original_qty, matched_qty, remaining_qty, match_status, create_time, update_time
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO binance_spot_trade_match_state (trade_id, uid, symbol, is_buyer, trade_time, original_qty, matched_qty, remaining_qty, match_status) SELECT t1.id, t1.uid, t1.symbol, t1.is_buyer, t1.time, t1.qty, 0, t1.qty, 'PENDING' FROM binance_trade_info t1 WHERE t1.uid = #{uid} AND t1.symbol = #{symbol} AND t1.qty > 0 AND t1.time IS NOT NULL AND t1.is_buyer IN (0, 1)
mapper.select: SELECT s.*, t.price, COALESCE(( SELECT SUM(c.core_qty) FROM binance_spot_core_position c WHERE c.uid = s.uid AND c.symbol = s.symbol AND c.trade_id = s.trade_id AND c.released_at IS NULL ), 0) AS active_core_qty FROM binance_spot_trade_match_state s INNER JOIN binance_trade_info t ON t.id = s.trade_id WHERE s.uid = #{uid} AND s.symbol = #{symbol} AND s.trade_id = #{tradeId} AND s.is_buyer = 1 FOR UPDATE

SELECT s.*, t.price FROM binance_spot_trade_match_state s INNER JOIN binance_trade_info t ON t.id = s.trade_id WHERE s.uid = #{uid} AND s.symbol = #{symbol} AND s.is_buyer = 0 AND s.remaining_qty > 0 AND s.match_status IN ('PENDING', 'PARTIAL') ORDER BY s.trade_time ASC, s.trade_id ASC FOR UPDATE

SELECT s.*, t.price, COALESCE(( SELECT SUM(c.core_qty) FROM binance_spot_core_position c WHERE c.uid = s.uid AND c.symbol = s.symbol AND c.trade_id = s.trade_id AND c.released_at IS NULL ), 0) AS active_core_qty FROM binance_spot_trade_match_state s INNER JOIN binance_trade_info t ON t.id = s.trade_id WHERE s.uid = #{uid} AND s.symbol = #{symbol} AND s.is_buyer = 1 AND s.remaining_qty > COALESCE(( SELECT SUM(c.core_qty) FROM binance_spot_core_position c WHERE c.uid = s.uid AND c.symbol = s.symbol AND c.trade_id = s.trade_id AND c.released_at IS NULL ), 0) AND s.match_status IN ('PENDING', 'PARTIAL') AND ( s.trade_time < #{sellTime} OR (s.trade_time = #{sellTime} AND s.trade_id < #{sellTradeId}) ) ORDER BY s.trade_time ASC, s.trade_id ASC FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE binance_spot_trade_match_state SET matched_qty = #{matchedQty}, remaining_qty = #{remainingQty}, match_status = #{matchStatus}, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id = #{id}
